status: Wake status is read-only; software notifications are armed in the saved ASUS run; physical entry cause unresolved

specification.title: USB4 Specification 2.0 November 2025 - CLEAN

router_detected.meaning: Reports connected-router detection; clears upon disconnect.

wake_on_connect_status.meaning: Records a connect wake generated with its wake enable set; clears on entry to sleep.

specification.interpretation: This is not a write-one-to-clear or software acknowledgement field. A set wake status does not itself establish current router detection or an unacknowledged PLUG notification.
specification.limit: Normative register semantics, not proof that ASUS implements them correctly or that a specific sleep transition occurred. Original PDF page visually checked; no vendor document republished.

native_code.scope: The reviewed pump initialises PlugStateManager from the starting state then registers the completion callback. GetLatestPlugStatus calls the software state-manager helper; this is not a fresh physical CS18 read.
native_code.limit: Code scope and matched symbols, not proof of hardware interrupt delivery. No claim that all controller or host RX code has been exhausted.

captured_notifications.meaning: Both retained initialisation passes prime software state as unplugged, start the notification pump successfully, arm it and report cached unplugged after RD No.
captured_notifications.limit: Software arming is observed; correct physical packet reception, interrupt delivery and full connection history are not established. Cached unplugged is not an independent PHY sample.

decision.status_clear_test: Not justified: the documented status is read-only.
decision.next_offline_question: Follow host RX PLUG-packet validation and notification completion in the retained exact host driver; compare existing Dell and ASUS records only where logging coverage can be qualified.
decision.unresolved: Actual ASUS PS8830/APU mode writer, physical negotiation history and a Windows repair remain unproven.
